## Requirements

1. `DefinitionInput::Ref`: a registry-backed definition-publishing
   surface + `open_session` resolving the ref to the pinned sealed
   definition — content-addressed, durable rows.
2. SSE: `GET /mcp` → `text/event-stream`, server-initiated push (the
   resources + tasks drain set moves to real push), `Last-Event-ID`
   resume without loss — deterministic, fixture-testable.
3. WS-H3 credential mediator seam: `oauth`/`mtls` `CallerCredential`
   kinds declared, resolved through the mediator to a subject where a
   path honestly exists, else typed refusal — no fake exchange, no
   secret material in ledgers or records.
4. DF rows carry dated progress/DONE lines; ADRs for owned decisions;
   BUILD_INDEX row 125; LEDGER advanced; verification green.

## Plan

- Leg 1 (`DefinitionInput::Ref`): `resolve_definition` registers the
  sealed definition into the service `RegistryStore` on the document
  path (idempotent, kernel registrar, `flush_registry_events` durable)
  and resolves a `ref` spelling (`version:<vid>` | bare vid |
  `ns/name[@label]` — the `hh_lab::assembly::desugar::base_definition`
  grammar, CC1) through `registry.resolve` at `Execute` mode —
  `UnresolvedRef` stays the typed answer for an unresolvable ref.
- Leg 2 (SSE): `serve_http` becomes a single-threaded nonblocking
  multiplex loop (`LabServer` is `!Send` — the serve thread is the only
  owner; no per-conn threads). A sequenced binding-scoped event log on
  `LabServer` (`push_notification` mints `seq` + keeps the legacy
  `pending` drain for `subscriptions/listen`); `GET /mcp` under a valid
  session + bearer answers `text/event-stream`, replays
  `Last-Event-ID`, then pushes live events.
- Leg 3 (mediator): `EmbedService::surface_verify_caller_token`
  (broker `verify_minted`) + `surface_mint_caller_token` (the kernel's
  own `minted_scoped` issue path — durable
  `granted`/`decided`/`bound`/`used` rows under the contract run);
  `LabServer::resolve_credential` composes the grant table (AS grant
  map) with the mediator leg — `oauth` credentials must verify,
  `mtls` is a typed refusal, `stdio_launch` grants unchanged; `401` on
  any refusal, never a fabricated subject.

## Test matrix

- `hh-embed` (`conformance.rs` — `s_open_ref_definition_resolves`):
  document open auto-registers → `version:<vid>` ref opens the same
  sealed definition; `lab.registry.publish` names it →
  `ns/name[@label]` ref opens; unknown ref → `UnresolvedRef`;
  revoked/unpublished stays typed; bytes land durable
  (`get_artifact` serves the ref-opened definition).
- `hh-mcp-lab` (new `r2_19.rs`): `GET /mcp` → 200
  `content-type: text/event-stream`; `resources/subscribe` + a touching
  `tools/call` pushes `notifications/resources/updated` on the stream
  with a monotonic `id:`; reconnect with `Last-Event-ID` replays without
  loss; bogus bearer → 401; `GET` without session → 400; oauth binding +
  broker-minted token → resolves and dispatches; forged oauth token →
  401 (`credential_invalid`); `mtls` grant → typed refusal leg.

## Progress

- 2026-10-09 — branch `svitali/harnessharness-r2.19` cut from `d954d7d`;
  baseline `cargo test -p hh-mcp-lab -p hh-embed-schema` green
  (mcp-lab 30 tests across cap_2/s4_11/s5_7/s5_8 + schema 14).
- 2026-10-09 — Leg 1 landed. `resolve_definition`'s document path now
  auto-registers `RegistryRecord::SealedDefinition` into the embedded
  `RegistryStore` (kernel registrar; idempotent on the
  content-addressed version id; a real registration failure refuses
  the open — CC3). New `resolve_ref_definition`: version spellings try
  the local blob pool first (`persisted_definition` verifies blob hash
  + pinned root), then the registry through the one `base_definition`
  grammar at `ResolveMode::Execute` (the desugar's `base:` read stays
  `Audit`; `base_definition` gained a `mode` parameter and went `pub`
  in `hh-lab::assembly::desugar`). A registry hit re-deposits the
  canonical bytes through the same blob/`artifacts/` chain — a
  ref-opened definition is byte-identical to a document-opened one.
- 2026-10-09 — Leg 2 landed. `serve_http` is a single-threaded
  nonblocking multiplex (accept → read → dispatch → push on the one
  `&mut LabServer` — `!Send`, no worker threads). New
  `ServerEvent{seq, binding_id, frame}` log (`EVENT_LOG_CAP = 4096`,
  tail-evict resumes at head) + the one `push_notification` mint that
  feeds both the SSE log and the `pending` drain (resources +
  tasks sites converted). `GET /mcp` validates session + credential,
  answers `200 text/event-stream`, replays `Last-Event-ID` (absent →
  tail; malformed → live — never a guessed cursor), then pushes live
  frames with liveness probing; POST/answer conns close after their
  reply.
- 2026-10-09 — Leg 3 landed. `EmbedService::surface_verify_caller_token`
  (broker `verify_minted` → `MintedVerdict`) +
  `surface_mint_caller_token` (channel `caller_auth` + per-audience
  binding — `granted`/`decided`/`bound`/`used` rows durable before the
  token answers; the token itself never enters a record).
  `CredentialRefusal` closed sum (`no_grant`/`credential_invalid`/
  `credential_expired`/`credential_revoked`/`transport_absent`) → the
  `401` challenge names it. `LabServer::resolve_credential` composes
  the grant table with the mediator: `oauth` verifies under the
  binding's declared `audience`, `mtls` refuses `transport_absent`
  (BL-31), `stdio_launch` unchanged. `MintedVerdict` re-exports through
  `hh_embed::service` — `hh-mcp-lab` carries no `hh-secrets` edge (the
  removability gate caught the first cut's direct dep; the re-export
  is the boundary-honest fix).
- 2026-10-09 — Batteries: `conformance.rs` gains
  `s_open_ref_definition_resolves` (bare vid + `version:<vid>` +
  `ns/name` via `lab.registry.publish` + unknown-ref `UnresolvedRef`;
  the existing unresolved-leg test updated); new
  `hh-mcp-lab/tests/r2_19.rs` ×3 (SSE push+resume, credential mediator
  resolve/refuse, 401 refusal spellings + 400 no-session).
- 2026-10-09 — Verification green: fmt/clippy clean, drift in sync,
  removability serial green (the S4.11 stanza proves the surface stays
  a leaf). DEFERRALS: DF-S1.25-1 + DF-S4.11-1 → DONE; DF-S4.11-2 →
  dated progress, OPEN (real OAuth provider + TLS-handshake legs are
  BL-31's environment-gated rows). BL-27 → dated progress, open.
  ADR-0351 records the five owned rulings.

## Gap analysis

| Clause | Gap | Disposition |
|---|---|---|
| changed-line budget (1300) | ~1,131 production+schema + ~757 battery (~1,888 total) — under budget on the production count; battery rides the AC matrix | Recorded honestly (the R2.6–R2.18 precedent); no generated artifacts touched |
| real OAuth provider exchange | needs a live AS | environment-gated — the kernel's own `minted_scoped` leg is the honest AS arm at this slice; DF-S4.11-2 stays OPEN; BL-31 |
| mTLS handshake → subject map | needs a TLS-terminating transport | typed `transport_absent` refusal — never a fabricated subject; DF-S4.11-2 stays OPEN; BL-31 |
| retained-log eviction | a `Last-Event-ID` older than the retained head can't replay what was evicted | honest semantics — resume starts at the head; the caller re-reads resource/task views (never a fabricated replay); `EVENT_LOG_CAP` documented |
| live-service evidence | none — offline-only honesty ceiling | fixture-verified only |
